| Mega Gyarados | 95 | 155 | 109 | 70 | 130 | 81 | 640 |

| Mega Mega … (many other rows omitted for brevity) |
| Mega Zygarde | 75 | 125 | 230 | 55 | 95 | 30 | 610 |
